تستدركوا (form X)
# تَسْتَدْرِكُوا (tastadrikū) /tas.tad.ri.kuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَدْرَكَ (istadraka)
# تُسْتَدْرَكُوا (tustadrakū) /tus.tad.ra.kuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَدْرَكَ (istadraka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
